title: Multi-level outdoor party patio?
content: Anybody know this place? Its an elevated outdoor party spot, pretty secluded and hidden by trees etc. The entrance is to the left at the dead-end of a forested gravel road, and cars can approach and park. You walk over to a black wrought iron perimeter fence and gate. There’s no gatekeeper but attendance is somehow by permission only. You enter the gate and then take switchback stairs going up. The levels of the switchback are built up by big rocks, and the perimeter fence runs up the right side of the stairs to the top level. The drop-off is pretty steep, and it could be dangerous without the fence. I know because I fell on the stairs once while leaving. At the top, there is another gate that has an attendant to verify you. Once you are in, it is quite the party scene. Copious food, alcohol, substances, and all sorts of crazy shenanigans! The crowd is racially and gender diverse and heavily queer, but not exclusively. People seem to reunite here and celebrate the scene as a rare opportunity to gather. There is a building of some sort, like a lodge or some type of headquarters, with people who work there to facilitate the event. Attendees only go in the building for reasons like needing medical assistance. The only rules I know of are absolutely no conflict of any sort (they will 86 you forever) and everyone MUST be back out the gates by dawn. This place is not always there/always open, and there is no signage, so I don’t know what to call it. I’ve gone several times and found it dark and quiet, or the access road was not where it should be. When it is open, it is obvious and you can see lights and hear music and people from a distance. Maybe the best way to describe it is a house party that happens a couple times a year. I’ve been going here randomly for many years, and am always stoked to run into people I haven’t seen for a while, none of whom I know in waking life. Anybody know the place?
